verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that the Unit Dashboard and APIs expose 'compliance' data to teams, and that Managed Solutions reduce operational ownership. Together these only hint that Unit carries some of the compliance workload. Nothing describes the actual tooling the story asks for. Missing for 10: transaction monitoring, sanctions/OFAC screening, alert case management, SAR-filing support, a documented split of compliance duties between customer, Unit and the partner bank, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
